text: Artificial intelligence is changing our world, but it also brings serious ethical questions. One major concern is bias, since AI systems can learn unfair patterns from flawed data, leading to discrimination in hiring or lending. Fairness means checking these systems carefully to reduce such harm. Privacy is another issue, because AI often collects personal information, and we need clear rules to protect it. Transparency is equally important: people should understand how AI makes decisions, not face a "black box." Ultimately, responsible AI development requires teamwork among engineers, lawmakers, and the public, and it means putting human well-being before profit or speed. Ethics must guide every step, from design to daily use.
